newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London track Wall St lower.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London track Wall St lower.

text.p: Hong Kong shares traded in London dipped on Thursday as worries about U.S. rates continued to keep investors on the sidelines, dealers said.

"It's just a bit drifty really. The U.S. initial jobless claims haven't helped things with the U.S. long bond coming off after signs of economic strength in the data and the Dow slipping lower," said one.
By 1405 GMT the Hang Seng London Reference index was down 49.30 points at 10,991.21.
U.S. August jobs data due on Friday is widely seen as a key factor in the Federal Reserve's decision-making at its meeting on interest rate policy later this month.
"Turnover is thin ahead of the U.S. payroll numbers so sellers are likely to get the upper hand," said the trader.
In Hong Kong overnight, fears about higher interest rates kept investors cautious and prompted some sellinng in rate sensitive sectors.
The Hang Seng index finished 36.44 points lower at 11,040.51.
